training-warrior-militia: At fifteen, {firstName} joined the city militia. Years of night watches and tavern brawls taught {{him|her|them}} never to leave a comrade behind.
training-warrior-arena: {firstName} learned to fight in the arenas of the south, where the crowd decides who lives, and won {{his|her|their}} freedom with a broken sword.
training-warrior-knight: An old knight took {firstName} into service and taught {{him|her|them}} that a shield is raised for others before oneself.
training-warrior-mercenary: {firstName} sold {{his|her|their}} sword to the Free Companies, crossed a dozen wars, and learned that loyalty is the rarest currency of all.
training-mage-academy: {firstName} studied at the Arcanum of Civitas, spending more nights in the library than in bed, and left with a master's ring and far too many questions.
training-mage-hedge: No academy would take {firstName}, so {{he|she|they}} learned magic from an old hedge-witch who paid in riddles and burned more soup than spells.
training-mage-wild: Magic awoke in {firstName} during a storm and set a barn on fire. Learning to master it took years of patience, and a few more barns.
training-mage-grimoire: {firstName} found a forbidden grimoire in a ruined chapel and taught {{himself|herself|themself}} from its whispering pages.
training-rogue-guild: The Shadow Guild took {firstName} in and taught {{him|her|them}} locks, rooftops, and the art of vanishing into a crowd.
training-rogue-street: On the streets, {firstName} survived on quick hands and quicker wits, until a queen of pickpockets saw talent where others saw trouble.
training-rogue-scout: {firstName} served with the scouts of a border fort, learning to move without a sound and to read the forest like an open book.
training-rogue-spy: A noble house trained {firstName} in espionage, teaching {{him|her|them}} to smile, to listen, and to forget nothing.
training-cleric-temple: {firstName} was raised in the temple of the Dawnfather, where prayers began before sunrise and healing was learned at the bedside of the poor.
training-cleric-vision: A fever brought a vision that changed everything: {firstName} woke with a god's voice in {{his|her|their}} heart and the power to heal in {{his|her|their}} hands.
training-cleric-battle: {firstName} followed the armies as a battle priest, a mace in one hand and bandages in the other.
training-cleric-pilgrim: {firstName} walked the long pilgrimage to the Seven Shrines and came back with calloused feet and an unshakable faith.
